tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// dpal phyag na rdo rje u tsārya'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru ratna wardhā ya/ phyag na rdo rje u tsārya bsgom par 'dod pas/ dkon mchog la blo gtad pa'i skyabs 'gro ci nus byas pa'i mthar/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod de/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bur gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i dbyings su pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig mthing nag las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de las 'od zer ser po 'phros 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems hūm̐ mthing nag de yongs su gyur pa las gnam lcags las grub ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ tshur 'dus rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas gnam lcags las grub pa'i rdo rje gdengs pa 'phyar thabs su 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba khro gnyer rab tu bsdus pa/

sku dang yan lag sbom la gsus khyim che ba/ rin po che'i chas brgyad dang klu chen brgyad kyis brgyan zhing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis klu rgyal rigs dkar po/ rje'u rigs ser po/ dmangs rigs nag po/ bram ze'i rigs khra bo rnams mnan pa/ sku lus kyis stong gsum gyi 'jig rten khengs shing*/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad khro chung gis gtams pa/ sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min dang lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra arghaṃ aḥhūm̐ zhes sogs rigs 'gres sbyar la/ oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs nas shabda āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi badzra shabda āḥhūm̐/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa nas// gsang sngags rig sngags kun gyi bdag po ste// log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'dul mdzad pa'i// bcom ldan rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rang nyid lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur gsal ba'i thugs kar padma nyi ma'i steng du rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar gnam lcags las grub pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa/

de'i lte bar rang gi sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas g.yas su bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas nad gdon sdig sgrib byad kha rbod gtong mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam zhing sems ma yengs par/ oṃ u tsa tsarya yakṣa se na aṃ ku sha dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

'di'i sngags la oṃ med pa mang na'ang*/ las dang po pas oṃ gyis mgo drangs te bzlas na rgyud 'jam pa yin no zhes bla ma rnams kyis gsungs so/ zhes pa gtso bor bzla/ spro na thun gsham du/ oṃ u tsa tsarya yakṣa se na aṃ ku sha dzaḥdzaḥ spu spu/ dan du nag po rbad// tsi tsidyas trag thur/ snying la thur/ nyams nyams/ rtsa bzhi skum/ shan shan/ srog la shan/ tsa tur nag po sod/ mā ra ya rbad/ 'dir gnod byed kyi ming spel sbyar/ tiṣṭha pra be sha ya rbad/ nā ga gu hya rbud/ pi pi ka li li ka dha dha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces sngags ring du grags pa'ang ci nus bzla/ thun 'jog pa na thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje'i bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba dang*/ gzhan gyi byad kha rbod gtong thams cad zlog pa dang*/ myur du dpal phyag na rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par zhu nas rang la thim/ rang phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis srung 'khor shin tu yangs pa'i nang du 'gro 'chag la sogs pa'i spyod lam rnams byed par bsam/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /phyag na rdo rje 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces sogs bsngo ba smon lam gang shes bya'o// gtor ma 'bul na/ snod gtsang mar gtor ma gnyis bshams pa'i dang po la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas ma dag pa bsang*/ swa bhā ba sogs stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min dang lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas dpal phyag na rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes pas spyan drang*/ thal mo kha gyen du phye ste gtor ma phul bas ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ u tsa sogs nas// dzaḥdzaḥb liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan lngas phul/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs dang*/ lcang lo can gyi pho brang dam pa nas// sogs kyi mthar gong gi/ bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje zhes sogs nas/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes pa'i bar brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol/ gnyis pa la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi mthar/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas srid pa'i sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa gtor snod kyi mthar byon te/ skad cig gis thams cad phyag na rdo rje'i skur gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐ zhes lan bdun gyis phul/ srid pa'i sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas rang gi gnas gsum bsrungs te/ muḥzhes pas mgron rnams dges bzhin du gshegs par bsams la/ bsngo ba dang bkra shis bya'o// phyag na rdo rje u tsārya'i sgrub thabs gtor chog dang bcas pa 'di nyams su len par spro ba'i las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i ched du btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis shin tu myur bar sbyar ba'o// ༈ /na mo gu ru ratna wardhā ya/ u tsārya'i rjes gnang bya ba'i tshul ni/ tshom bu'i mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ gtor ma gnyis/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu me tog rnams lta gon bya/

bum pa gcig cho ga bzhin bsham/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa byin gyis brlab/ bdag bskyed bsgom/ tshom bu'i lha yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ mchod bstod/ gtor ma lha dang sde brgyad la phul/ bzlas pa bya/ bum pa'i nang du lha sngar bzhin bskyed/ mchod bstod bzlas pa byas la mthar mchod yon phul bas lha 'od du zhu ba'i chur bsam/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ de yang phyag na rdo rje la che ba bzhi las/ u tsārya drag sngags kyi che ba dang ldan par grags pa'i dpal phyag na rdo rje'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyi bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub nas/ khyed rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ slob dpon phyag na rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// bdag ni 'gro la phan don du// brtse chen khyed la gsol 'debs kyis// ma lus rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag pa'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i phyag na rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par mos pa byas/ de dag gi spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ces pas rgyud dag par byas nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/

lus ngag yid gsum nus pa dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la/ sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas haṃ/ zhes brjod pas khyed rang gis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dang*/ rnam smin gyi gdos bcas sha khrag gis bsdus pa'i phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bur gyur ces sogs nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po zhes pa'i bar slob ma lhar bskyed/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ lcang lo can gyi phyag na rdo rje'i thugs ka nas phyag na rdo rje'i sku dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ khyed rang la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod ces dang*/ u tsa bzla zhing rol mo bya/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis dbang lha spyan drangs/ gsol ba gdab pa'i rjes zlos byas la bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab/ des sku'i rjes gnang thob/ lus kyi bar chad zhi bar byas/ lus bcom ldan 'das kyi skur byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du khyed rang gi thugs kar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag cig bsgoms te/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung zhal nas thon/ khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig la thim zhing sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pas/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas nad gnod sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs par mos pa byas nas me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ u tsa dang*/ spro na sngags ring yang bzlas la dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/

gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos shing*/ slob dpon la me tog gtor te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis sogs nas/ bdag la 'go bar mdzod ces gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon gyis me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas te khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlab par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs nas/ 'di la 'go bar mdzod/ rdo rje slob ma 'di'i rgyud la bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig des gsung gi rjes gnang thob ces sogs gong gi ngo sprod 'don pa bsgyur/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ lcang lo can gyi phyag na rdo rje'i thugs kar phog pas/ de thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul te thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rdo rje rtse lnga pa dpag tu med pa byung ste/ khyed rang gi thugs kar thim par mos pa mdzod ces sngags dang rol chen bya/ des thugs kyi rjes gnang thob ces sogs ngo sprod 'don pa bsgyur/ de ltar khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin can gyi bdag nyid nga yin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra pa ṇi kā ya wāktsitta badzra swabhā wa ātmako3haṃ/ zhes pas nga rgyal bzung*/ de la rab tu gnas par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha sogs dang me tog gtor/ mchod par mos te/ oṃ badzra puṣpe nas shabda āḥhūm̐ rol mo bya zhing*/ nyin mo bde legs sogs kyis bkra shis byas la/ mtha' rten gtor ma la brten nas bka' bsgo ba ni/ gtor ma bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjer mos pa byas te/

khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag nas bka' bsgo bar mos pa mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyis byin brlabs shing*// dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung 'gyur ba'i// gtor ma'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya// zhes dang sngags thung gi mthar/ bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la rtag tu 'bral ba med pa bzhugs nas/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar gyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad zhugs nas rang dang gzhan gyi don thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub pa dang*/ mthar thug bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje'i go 'phang bde blag tu thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod pas gtor ma phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba de las phyag na rdo rje'i sku mthe bong gi tshad tsam pa zhig chad de khyed rang gi spyi bor thim par mos pa mdzod/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub/ gtso bos maṇḍal deng nas sogs spyi dang 'dra/ tshom bu'i lha la mchod bstod bzod gsol byas la ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus la bkra shis dang dga' ston bya'o// 'di'ang btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis sbyar ba'o// ༈ /dpal phyag na rdo rje u tsārya'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor nyer mkho'i yi ge rdo rje'i me char ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī badzra pā ṇi ye/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'i skor las u tsārya drag sngags kyi che ba zhes yongs su rdzogs pa'i gdams pa zab la nyer mkho'i man ngag cung zad 'chad pa la gsum las/ dang po bsnyen pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje gang yang rung ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang*/ 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas gnas dben zhing yid dang mthun par 'di'i bris sku'am rten dgram pa'i mdun du gtor ma gnyis mchod pa dang bcas pa bsham/

mar ngo'i gza' skar drag po'i las la shis pa'i srod thun nas brtsams te bsnyen pa la 'jug de yang dad pa dang nges 'byung dang snying rje shugs drag tu bskyed de/ gnas skabs dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthar thug phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dpal gsang ba'i bdag po'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir bsnyen sgrub la 'jug par bgyi'o snyam pa'i blos skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ltar bya/ bzlas dmigs kyi skabs rang gi lce hūm̐ las gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu rwa gdengs pa/ rwa re re bzhin sngags kyi phreng bas mtshan cing ye shes kyi me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro bar gsal btab la bzla/ skabs su thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer dang me phung gi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs/ ba spu'i bu ga rnams su khro chung dpag tu med pas gang bas sngags kyi sgra di ri ri sgrog par bsam/ yang khro chung rnams las rang 'dra ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ rang la gnod pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad tshar bcad cing zhal du gsol/ dges pa'i nyams dang bcas te ba spu'i rtsa ba'i khro chung rnams la thim par bsam te bzla ba'ang man ngag go /de lta bu'i rim pas thun bzhir bcad la nyams su blang*/ phyi thun gyi mjug tu gtor ma sgrub thabs las 'byung ba ltar phul/ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na gshegs gsol sogs dkyus ltar bya/ grangs bsnyen gyi tshad sngags thung 'bum phrag bcu drug gam bcu bdun/ dus bsnyen zla ba gsum/ mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa rab dngos su bris sku bzhad pa dang*/ 'od 'byung ba dang*/ sgra 'byin pa dang*/ mngon shes 'char ba sogs 'byung bar gsungs la/ 'bring nyams kyi skabs su de ltar 'char pa dang*/

tha ma'ang rmi lam du glegs bam mang du mthong zhing lag tu len pa dang*/ rol mo sgrog pa/ chos nyan bshad byed pa/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba/ yi dam gyi sku dang phyag mtshan rnyed pa/ lo ma dang*/ me tog dang*/ 'bras bu dang*/ nyi zla dang*/ gza' skar mthong ba/ rdzing dang khron pa nas chu 'dren pa/ gcan gzan gyi pags pa'i gos gyon pa/ rgyan thogs pa/ mtshon cha rnon po bzung ba sogs byung na'ang nges par dngos grub ci rigs pa thob par 'gyur bar gsungs so// de lta bu'i rtags mthong ba'am/ bsnyen pa sum cha tsam grub nas thun thams cad kyi mthar sngags ring sbrel ba'ang cung zad re bzla/ gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ rang gi mdun du 'di'i bris sku mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dgram/ 'bur sku yin na maṇḍal gyi dbus bzhugs su gsol/ mdun du gtor ma dang mchod pa bsham/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i mdun gyi rten rjes gnang gi skabs ltar lhar bskyed/ thugs ka'i sngags 'khor gsal btab/ de nas rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa me 'bar ba dang bcas te byung*/ zhal nas thon/ mdun bskyed kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pas thugs rgyud bskul/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng byung*/ lte ba nas thon/ rang gi lte ba nas zhugs thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pas lha dbang du 'dus te rgyud byin gyis brlab par bsams la/ de lta bu'i 'od zer spro bsdu rgyun ma chad pa'i ngang nas bzla/ thun bzhi ka'i mthar mdun bskyed la mchod bstod gtor 'bul nongs bshags brtan bzhugs bsngo smon shis brjod rgyas par bya/ de'ang bsnyen pa'i skabs su rtags ma byung na 'dir rtags ma mthong gi bar dang*/ bsnyen rtags byung na zhag bdun nam nyer gcig sogs ci nus su bzlas pas don 'grub bo// gsum pa las sbyor la/ ting nge 'dzin la brten pa'i las sbyor dngos dang*/

de las gzhan pa'i las tshogs so// dang po ni/ bsnyen sgrub la rtags thon nas gdug pa can tshar bcad pa'i slad du me dmigs rnam pa bzhi bsgom pa ste/ de la dang po me 'bar klong chen gyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i mjug tu/ thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ la sems gtad pas me 'bar/ des ye shes sems dpa' nyid kyang mer gyur te lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib rtog tshogs dang bcas pa bsregs/ phyir 'phros sa gsum khyab cing sngags kyi rang sgra sgrog par bsams la bzla/ 'phro 'du khro bo'i ting 'dzin ni/ rang gi sku'i cha shas dang khro chung thams cad las rang 'dra ba'i sku dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib rtog tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad bsad bskrad mnan zos bsregs gtub tshar bcad/ slar rang lus la thim/ lus thams cad kyang khro bo'i sku dpag tu med pa dang*/ tshar bcad pa'i rnam shes rnams kyang phyag na rdo rje'i skur gyur/ sgrar grags pa rnams drag po'i sngags su bsams la bzla/ mgal me lta bu'i ting 'dzin ni/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'bar ba'i me steng 'og tu spros pas lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad gang*/ lhag ma spyi gtsug dang gsang gnas nas sgra bcas 'phros/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad khyab cing mgal me ltar 'khor bas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang nad gdon tshar bcad par bsams la bzla/ nam mkha' gnam lcags kyi ting 'dzin ni/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang sngags phreng las 'bar ba'i mes rang lus ye shes sems dpa' dang bcas pa lcags gong mer bsregs pa bzhin dmar lam gyis song bar bsams la bzla/ de ltar bzla lugs rnam pa bzhi po la dmigs pa cung zad brtan pas skabs 'ga' zhig tu phyogs gcig tu dril nas bzla ba ni/

thugs ka'i sems dpa' gnyis po hūm̐ las 'bar ba'i mes lcags bsregs pa bzhin dmar lam gyis song ba las me dmar nag tu 'bar/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ rtsa phran bdun cu rtsa gnyis mer 'bar/ gdon bgegs thams cad bsregs pa'i thal ba stod smad nas me lces phyir ded de lus kyi phyi nang thams cad me lces khyab ba spu'i rtsa ba na bzhugs pa'i khro chung rnams las rang 'dra bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ mthar snang grags thams cad lha sngags su gyur te bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/ gdon bgegs rnams zhal du gsol/ sku las skyes pa'i mes snang ba'i dngos po thams cad ye shes kyi me phung gcig tu gyur par bsams la drag sngags gtso bor bzla/ drag po'i sngags 'di 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pas las thams cad 'grub par gsungs so// gnyis pa de las gzhan pa'i las tshogs la/ thog mar rdzas kyi sbyor ba ni/ dri chen/1

rnal 'byor pa rang ga ི gla rtsi/2 spyang ki'i brun/3 mi tshil/4 gu gul nag po/5 sbru ba nag po/6 chu rtsa/7 thar nu/8 stag sha9 mtshal dkar/10 rta rmig gi gzhob/11 sgog skya nus bsregs kyi thal ba/12 ra ru'i gzhob/13 rdo dreg dmar po/14 mu zi nag po/15 re lcag pa'i rtsa ba/16 rgya tshwa/17 shing kun 18 te rdzas sna bco brgyad po tshul bzhin du sbyar la zhib par btags/ rnal 'byor pa rang gi dri chu bar pas ril bu dril ba thod pa'i nang du blugs/ de'i steng du nyi dkyil la sngags phreng bkod nas bzlas pas ril bu'i ma dag pa thams cad sbyangs shing nus pa mchog tu bskyed par bsams la sngags ring gtso bor bzla/ thun 'jog pa na sngags phreng gdan dang bcas pa ril bu la thim par bsams nas has btab la bsngags/ de ltar brtson pas grub pa'i rtags ril bu la drod dang rlangs pa sogs 'byung bar 'gyur ro// de nas las la sbyar ba dngos ni/ mdze nad gso ba la/ dang por legs par brtag ngos zin nas sgrib sbyong dang zhi ba'i cho ga yun du bya/ des ma phan na rten 'brel rdzas kyis lus gzhom pa zhes gong gi ril bu nyid dri chu bar pa'am mar nag dang sbyar nas lus la khyab par byug ma khyab na spyi bo/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba/ rkang mthil gnyis te gnas bdun du byug khyad par gang mi bde ba'i sar byugs la me'am nyi mas bdug pas lpags pa'i nad thams cad la phan/ ril bu bdun la sogs pa tho rangs ro sol gyi mer bsregs nas bdug pas bgegs thams cad dpag tshad du byer ro// dri chu bar pa dang sbyar te khrus byas pas mi gtsang ba thams cad sel/ nya mig tsam re dri chu bar pa la sbyar nas lto stong la khong du btang bas khong srung du 'gyur/ rdzas kyi thum bu rang gzhan la gdags na nad gdon thams cad srung bar 'gyur ro// nus pa'i rno so 'don pa la/ shu dag nag po/ ru rta/ bong nga*/ sgog skya/ phag tshil/ ro'i bdud rtsi/

byin rlabs can gyi gdung rus/ nya mkhris rnams cha mnyam par sbyar ro// nus pa sngags kyis ngag gzhom pa ni drag sngags bar med du bzla/ rig pa sems kyis yid gzhom pa ni me dmigs kyi ting 'dzin shin tu gsal bar bya ste/ de rnams thams cad mtshungs ldan du nyams su blangs pas 'og gdon mdze nad las grol ba ni nges pa'o// bar gdon smyo 'bog gso na/ ro ras sam ro skra las byas pa'i thag pas nad pa'i srin lag bsdams pa'i sne nas bzung*/ rang yi dam gyi nga rgyal drag po dang bcas bong bu'am ro sol gyi me la rdzas sna bco brgyad bsregs pa'i dud pas 'dom dang sna bug nas bdug drag sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshon chas gzir bas skad ngan rtse re re 'ong ste/ de tsa na gdon gang yin dris la phyin chad gnod pa mi byed pa'i mna' dgag go /gal te skad mi 'don par brgyal na/ rdzas rnams khyi lud kyi me la bsregs nas bdug drag sngags la sde brgyad kyi srog sngags hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar du btags pas gzir bas ngo ston par 'gyur la/ de'i tshe mna' dgag rdzas kyi thum bu mgul du gdags shing gnas bdun du thig le byas pas bsrung ngo*// sri'u gso na/ rdzas kyi thum bu mgul du gdags shing lus la byug sri'u ma dang bcas pa me 'bar klong chen gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi khongs su bcug nas drag sngags bzla/ srung 'khor kyang srung 'khor ni/ phyag rdor gyi thugs kar 'khor lo rtsibs bcu mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte bar bsrung bya'i ming dang spel tshig rtsibs bcu la sngags thung*/ mu khyud la sngags ring dgod/ gla rtsi dang dgur gum gyi byug bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i 'khor lo'i yig 'bru rnams khro bor bskyed la sngags brgya rtsa bzla gtor ma phul/ lha rnams yig 'brur bsams la rten snying bdun gyis brtan bzhugs bya/ gdags so/ rims nad srung na/ rdzas kyi thum po mgul du gdags/

dri chu bar pa dang sbyar te lus kyi gnas rnams su byugs pa dang*/ bdug pa dang*/ tho rangs khong srung ril bu re re btang ngo*// gdon phra mo gso ba dang srung na/ rdzas la sngags btab pa'i chus byugs pa dang khong du btang ba dang*/ snar bdug pa sogs bgyis pas 'bras dang*/ shu ba'i rigs/ gag lhog rma rnying 'tshor mi 'dod pa sogs thams cad la phan no// lto srung ni/ tho rangs dri chu bar pa la rdzas nya mig tsam re btab pa'am/ yang na sngags nyer gcig bzlas nas btang bas bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cus mi tshugs shing*/ zhugs pa'ang phyir thon par 'gyur ro// gzhan yang mngon spyod kyi las dang*/ srung 'khor chen mo sogs lag len btab dka' bas gzhan du shes par bya'o// yang 'di'i rjes gnang gi skabs nad gdon drag pos gzir ba la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang byed na/ bzlas lung gi mjug tu dpon slob gnyis kas me dmigs rnam pa bzhi gsal btab/ mtshams rnams su drag sngags lan gsum re bzla/ rdzas dud kyis bdug rol mo bya/ de nas thugs kyi rjes gnang sogs dkyus ltar sbyar bar bya gsungs/ bzlas pa'i skabs yig rnying phal cher du snying gar rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i lte bar ye shes sems dpa' dang*/ de'i thugs kar nyi gdan la ting 'dzin sems dpa'i mthar sngags 'khor bkod pa dang*/ drag sngags bzlas skabs/ mdun du sprul pa'i khyung nag mgo dgu/ g.yas su mgon po gri gug g.yon du lha mo bong zhon ma/ mtha' skor kun tu dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga rnams gus pas 'khod par bsams la bka' bsgo ba'i tshul gyis bzla bar gsungs pa'ang snang ngo*// mdor na lhag pa'i lha 'di'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum tshul bzhin du byas te/ rgyun du'ang bsnyen pa dang*/ las sbyor bzhi po gcig tu dril ba'i bzlas pa byas na klu gdon gtso bor gyur pa'i gdug pa can thams cad zhi zhing nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba dang*/

mthar thug yi dam lha yis rgyud byin gyis brlabs nas dngos grub mchog thob par 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o// zhes pa'ang tshul 'di'i rjes gnang dang man ngag gi lag len cung zad thos pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos dpal gsang ba'i bdag pos mngon sum du rjes su bzung ba'i grub pa'i slob dpon snye mdo ba bla chen shākya dpal sogs kyis mdzad pa'i yig rnying mang po las nyer mkho mdo tsam btus pa 'dis kyang 'gro kun dngos grub rnam pa gnyis la dbang 'byor ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ ༈ /phyag na rdo rje u tsārya'i rjes gnang gi brgyud 'debs byin rlabs char 'bebs bzhugs so// rdo rje 'chang dbang dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag /padma badzra klu sgrub tsand+ra'i zhabs// dharma pha la bla ma zangs gling pa// khams pa a seng rnams la gsol ba 'debs// zhang ston dkon mchog smon mkhar skyi ston pa// dkon blo chos grags e pa 'khon ston che// mchog ldan rgyal 'od slob dpon smra seng dang*// byang chub seng ge rnams la= /sa bzang 'phags pa ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// grags rgyal legs 'byung dkon mchog lhun grub dpal// dkon mchog rgya mtsho mchog legs rdo rje dang*// bstan 'dzin bzang po rnams la= /mkhyen rab byams pa rmor chen gnas gsar ba// kun dga' blo gros rin chen rgyal mtshan dang*// kun dga' bkra shis 'khon ston ā nanda// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// drag sngags mthar thug gsang bdag u tsārya'i// bsnyen sgrub las sbyor ye shes me phung gis// sa gsum gdug pa ma lus bsregs byas nas// grub gnyis snang ba rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'ang mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa dge legs su gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/
skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
